summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on firmware and embedded systems experience across STM32, Arduino, and Jetson platforms. Built bare-metal C firmware with direct GPIO, timer, ADC, and I2C register control, plus FreeRTOS based real-time task coordination, and debugged multi-board hardware integration issues down to root cause. Background also includes digital signal processing work, including custom wavelet filtering for noise suppression, and PCB design and fabrication in EAGLE.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a wearable gesture recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
